text_block_list.text:
With a fantastic performance in the
Twinkle
Series, Mihono Bourbon has had
an impressive
first three years.

One peaceful day, after reaching that
milestone...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Would you like to come with me to visit
my
family?

I end up accompanying Mihono Bourbon
to her
parents' house.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I asked you to come for two reasons.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
First, my father is always saying that he
wants to
meet you.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Now that our race schedule has settled
down, I
have determined that there are
no problems with
being away from the
academy.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: The other reason is...
She stops mid-sentence.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: There is a matter that I must verify.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...We will arrive at the closest station to
my home
soon. Please make
preparations to disembark.

She takes me to a simple house in the
remote
countryside.

A kind-looking man is waiting at the
entrance.

text_block_list.name: Bourbon's Father
text_block_list.text: Welcome home, Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Father. Please meet my
trainer.

text_block_list.name: Bourbon's Father
text_block_list.text:
I've heard so much about you. Thank you
for
taking care of my daughter.

text_block_list.name: Bourbon's Father
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry I couldn't come to the academy
to meet
you. Our house is a bit small,
but please make
yourself at home.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Here is the souvenir you requested,
Father.

text_block_list.name: Bourbon's Father
text_block_list.text:
Oh, thank you. So, this is that special
carrot
bread everyone's talking about...

text_block_list.name: Bourbon's Father
text_block_list.text:
Please, make yourself at home. I'll go
get you
something to drink.

I look around the room and see a photo
of a very
young Mihono Bourbon
displayed on a shelf.

She's holding a flag with "#1" written on
it, and
flashing a peace sign at the
camera, all while
maintaining a poker
face.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
According to my data logs, this is a
photo of the
first time I ever finished in
first place in a race.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
It was just after I decided I wanted to
win the
Classic Triple Crown. I recall
feeling "elated" at
the time.

The room is adorned with other trophies
and
medals, as well as old caricatures
she drew.

An old ticket for the Japanese Derby in
particular
catches my attention.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
That is... unknown. It was not here
before.

She tilts her head in confusion as her
father
returns with a tray of tea.

text_block_list.name: Bourbon's Father
text_block_list.text:
It's a ticket stub from when I took
Bourbon to the
Japanese Derby for the
first time.

text_block_list.name: Bourbon's Father
text_block_list.text:
Since she's been gone, I've been digging
out
things like this. I'm a bit of an old
sop, I have to
admit...

text_block_list.name: Bourbon's Father
text_block_list.text:
It was after Bourbon watched the race
that day
that she said she wanted to be
a Triple Crown
champion.
choice_data_list: 大切なものなんですね
choice_data_list_en: It's something precious to you, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Bourbon's Father
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure you know, but she's not really
the type to
go around expressing her
desires.

text_block_list.name: Bourbon's Father
text_block_list.text:
So I couldn't have been happier. We
started
training together after that.

I remember Bourbon telling me that her
father
started training her when she was
young.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Father was a trainer, so I have run
exhaustive
routines since youth. In other
words, I am used to
it.

Thanks to the habits she's maintained
since a
young age, she has the physical
strength and
mental fortitude to endure
tough training.

As I excitedly go on and on about how
beneficial
that training turned out to be
for Mihono
Bourbon, her father
scratches his head bashfully.

text_block_list.name: Bourbon's Father
text_block_list.text: I really didn't do anything special.

text_block_list.name: Bourbon's Father
text_block_list.text: More important is what you have done for her. I've been wanting to thank you.

text_block_list.name: Bourbon's Father
text_block_list.text:
No. You turned racing into something
more than
just a Triple Crown dream for
her.

text_block_list.name: Bourbon's Father
text_block_list.text:
Seeing her cry those tears of joy at the
Arima
Kinen while the crowd went wild...

text_block_list.name: Bourbon's Father
text_block_list.text:
I may have only seen it on TV, but I'll
never forget
it for as long as I live.

text_block_list.name: Bourbon's Father
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for taking care of my

daughter.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Father...

We relax for a little while after that and
then
leave.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much for meeting my
father,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
It is rare for him to be so talkative. He
must have
been very happy.

On our way here, Mihono Bourbon said
that there
was a matter that she needed
to verify.
choice_data_list: そういえば、確かめたかったことって？
choice_data_list_en: Come to think of it, what was it that you wanted to check?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
That is... well... the difference between
you and
my father.

I can't help but ask her to elaborate
after hearing
such an unexpected
response.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I used to believe that you were similar to
my
father.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
You both treat my dream with respect,
and you
have both walked with me on
my path to achieve
it.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
However, after the Arima Kinen, I felt
that I may
have been mistaken.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
My emotions rose beyond expected
levels on that
day as I returned to your
side.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I have realized that my emotional state
has
gained some degree of volatility
since I met you.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
This emotional volatility feels pleasant,
and has
become a factor in making my
life feel more
enriched...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
When I realized this... It's difficult to
express, but
I felt that you were
different from my father.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Today, I... wanted to verify that feeling.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
The two of you are similar in many ways.
You
both believe in me and continue to
stick with me.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
However, there is certainly a difference.
I cannot
explain it sufficiently, but...
She looks at me straight in the eyes.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
You are my trainer and I cherish the time
we
spend together greatly.

It could just be the light of the sunset,
but her
cheeks turn slightly red.

It feels like my journey with Mihono
Bourbon has
started anew.
